basic_info.description: Stunning Renovated Condo in the heart of Prestigious Pacific Heights! Discover luxurious living in this exquisitely renovated condo. With over $200K in premium upgrades, this home showcases elegance, thoughtful design, and superior craftsmanship. Step into a sunlit space with refinished hardwood floors, oversized windows, and vintage built-ins and millwork that create an inviting ambiance for relaxation and entertaining. The chef's kitchen features a spacious island with counter seating, a breakfast nook with custom built-in banquette, high-end stainless-steel appliances, marble countertops, and custom cabinetry. The serene primary offers an expanded closet and vintage moldings. The spa-inspired bathroom features Carrera marble floors, frameless glass rain shower with two shower heads, and double vanity with designer finishes. The second bedroom and full guest bathroom are equally luxurious with sleek updates and top-tier finishes. Extras include a cozy gas fireplace, in-unit laundry with premium washer/dryer, updated electrical and plumbing, ample storage room that can also store bikes. Out the front door is iconic Fillmore Street: restaurants, cafes, shopping, markets, and much more plus recreation at Alta Plaza Park a block away. Walk score 95, Transit 85!
